name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 7 – Am 11
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 7b. Is deeply concerned by the recent case involving a former Member of the European Parliament who allegedly received EUR 900 000 from a major automotive company while serving as an MEP, allegedly in exchange for tabling amendments in its interests and who was in direct discussion with it in the context of legislative files in Parliament; stresses that all such allegations must be investigated independently and effectively;
